text:
Just got off a call from the patrol guy near Wonowon BC. He was flying the line this morning
and spotted a sheen down in Coulee Creek around 10:45. Followed it back to the right-of-way
and found a wet spot on the bank, looks like it's coming from the pipe body. No active leak
now, just residual product sitting in the snow.
Called in, we shut the line remotely pretty quick-no pressure left in the segment. Patrol
walked the ROW, no other signs. Metering at the station says we lost about 5.0 m³. Ground's
frozen, so it didn't soak in too deep, but there's some staining.
He mentioned the pipe wall looks thinned, kinda rough and pitted where the wet spot was.
Sounds like corrosion, maybe internal. No holes he could see, just a bad patch. That's all for
now.
-Dave R., Contract Patrol Pilot
